entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands
comments: # The human-command registry (ctx.commands).  Producers register global
# slash commands here; an interactive adapter discovers and dispatches
# them without a model turn.  This stage composes no adapter (the driver
# is headless), so the commands stay registered-but-uninvoked — the
# service is the product surface a UI plugs into, same contract as the
# dormant /plan command noted at L7.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact
comments: # /compact: human-triggered manual compaction.  inject [commands,
# compaction] — the backend is L9's dsh-compaction-basic, so the
# command registers over the seam that already exists.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal
comments: # /goal: human control over the L7 goal domain (show / create / edit /
# pause / resume / clear).  inject [commands, goals] — both satisfied.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-command-feedback
comments: # ENABLED: dsh-anonymous-user-id peer is now installed.
# /feedback: log-only session feedback producer + slash command.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user
comments: # ask_user_question: the model-facing Consumer for the L7
# user-questions seam (inject [tools, userQuestions] — both mounted).
# Headless there is still no UI provider, so a call fails with the
# seam's clear NO_PROVIDER error instead of hanging — the tool now
# EXISTS for the model, and mounting any UI provider later activates it
# with zero composition changes here.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # All three limits are REQUIRED — the library ships no defaults.
    # fallbackMaxBytes must not exceed maxTitleBytes.
    fallbackMaxWords: 8
    fallbackMaxBytes: 48
    maxTitleBytes: 96
comments: # Log-backed session titles (ctx.sessionTitle).  The first human
# message schedules a deterministic first-words fallback, persisted
# as a log-only session/title event (replayable, zero model tokens).
# With L10's projection registry mounted it also folds a 'title'
# projection unit.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm
comments: # ENABLED: the shared dsh-session-title-llm package is now installed.
# First-message LLM title provider (falls back to first-words on error).
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # all keys required (shared SessionTitleLlm schema) — route matches
    # the stage's own gateway, targets match dsh-session-title limits
    provider: local-anthropic
    model: deepseek-v4-flash
    targetWords: 8
    targetCjkCharacters: 16
    maxInputBytes: 4096
    maxOutputTokens: 32
    timeoutMs: 30000

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-persona
comments: # DISABLED — scope-only row: mounted at the global context its
# deployment:persona section collides with dsh-system-prompt's own
# unconditional registration and fails the boot ("prompt section ...
# is already registered").  It belongs inside an agent preset
# (agent.ctx scope), which this composition does not compose.  The
# deployment-level persona remains dsh-system-prompt's own `persona`
# config — frozen since L4 for the single-variable ladder.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # Both keys REQUIRED.  This is the composition base of the
    # 'agent-default-model' Settings section — L11's settings-file provider
    # layers a user's saved selection over it live.  The values name the
    # exact route this stage already drives through dsh-llm-pi-ai.
    provider: local-anthropic
    model: deepseek-v4-pro
comments: # ctx.agentDefaultModel: the process-wide default an entry point
# reads when creating an Agent with no session-local selection — the
# model choice stops being hardcoded per entry point.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation
comments: # DISABLED — scope-only like persona: tools.presentAs() throws on an
# unscoped context ("requires a scoped context (agent.ctx)").  The
# process-global presentation is the `mode` config field on the
# dsh-tools row itself; this row exists so an agent PRESET can
# declare native/code/both for its own agents.  Listed for closure
# visibility.
